decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing a strong board presence with fast and aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Voice of Victory. It also includes removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to efficiently deal damage to the opponent while maintaining board control, using cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to close out the game. Additionally, it includes utility cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Seasoned Pyromancer to provide card advantage and flexibility in different situations.

This deck focuses on combining reanimation spells like Persist and Unearth with powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty to quickly overwhelm the opponent with threats. Utilizing cards like Faithless Looting and Thoughtseize to fill the graveyard and disrupt the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to bring back huge creatures early in the game to control the board and secure victory. The key strategy is to efficiently discard and reanimate creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan to establish dominance on the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to generate mana and search for specific creatures in the deck. By utilizing cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Nature's Rhythm, the player can assemble powerful combinations of creatures on the battlefield quickly and efficiently. The toolbox aspect of the deck allows for flexibility in responding to different situations, while cards like Leyline of Abundance provide additional support for mana production. Ultimately, the goal is to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent with a well-orchestrated combination of creatures and abilities.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with powerful enters-the-battlefield abilities, such as Flickerwisp and Quantum Riddler, to repeatedly blink them with cards like Ephemerate and Teferi, Time Raveler. This allows for efficient removal and disruption of opponents' strategies while also providing value and card advantage. By combining aggro strategies with blink effects, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with its powerful creatures and disruptive plays, creating a fast-paced and dynamic game plan that can catch opponents off guard.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. By using a combination of spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, along with creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing its own win condition. The inclusion of cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation allows the deck to deal with a variety of threats, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and additional control options. Overall, the deck is designed to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in a control-oriented fashion.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on using a mix of counter spells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and out-value the opponent. With a variety of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, along with counter magic like Counterspell and Force of Negation, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while developing its own board presence. The deck also includes card draw and selection with cards like Preordain and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, allowing the player to find the right answers at the right time.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents' game plans with a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to control the game through card advantage, denying opponents resources, and maintaining tempo. It utilizes a mix of efficient creatures and spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck's strategy is to outvalue opponents by efficiently answering threats while advancing its own game plan. It aims to grind opponents out of resources, eventually overwhelming them with its powerful spells and card advantage.

This deck focuses on assembling an aggressive board presence quickly, utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge allows for additional damage and removal capabilities. Thoughtseize helps disrupt opponents' game plans, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides a powerful finisher. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the board throughout the game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through disruption and removal spells like Thoughtseize, Prismatic Ending, and Spell Snare. It also utilizes creatures with powerful abilities like Solitude and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to control the board. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps to keep the opponent's strategies in check. The deck also has access to powerful card draw options like Cling to Dust and Meticulous Archive. The mana base is designed to help cast the deck's spells efficiently and consistently.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Tower, and Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It uses control elements like Karn, the Great Creator, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Thought-Knot Seer and Emrakul, the Promised End to close out the game. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to further hinder the opponent's strategy. The strategy revolves around efficiently ramping into powerful threats and controlling the game until victory is achieved.

The key concept of this Allosaurus Combo deck is to utilize cards like Allosaurus Rider, Eldritch Evolution, Neoform, and Summoner's Pact to quickly and efficiently tutor for and cheat out powerful creatures such as Griselbrand, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, Xenagos, God of Revels, and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. The deck also includes tools like Veil of Summer and Pact of Negation to protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent's strategy. By assembling the combo pieces efficiently, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful creature combos and win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck utilizes cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Mutagenic Growth to deal damage and control the board. Additionally, cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration allow for card advantage and selection. The mana base is optimized to provide the necessary colors for the spells while still maintaining tempo. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of aggressive threats and efficient spells.

This deck focuses on using control elements to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful Eldrazi creatures. It utilizes cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Eldrazi Temple to get ahead on mana, while also running removal spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to control the board. The deck aims to play big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to quickly close out the game. Overall, this deck is built to overwhelm opponents with large, hard-to-answer threats while maintaining control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards and manipulate the graveyard in order to cast Living End, which allows the player to return all creatures from their graveyard to the battlefield. This combo can be achieved by using cards like Street Wraith, Shardless Agent, and Endurance to either cycle through the deck or disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Negation to protect the combo. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a board full of creatures after casting Living End.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and counterspells. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Quantum Riddler, Psychic Frog, and Harbinger of the Seas while also utilizing Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card advantage. With cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's strategy early on, the deck aims to maintain control of the game until it can establish a win condition through cards like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp and find ways to discard Cosmogoyf and Devourer of Destiny into the graveyard. By using cards like Spoils of the Vault, Plunge into Darkness, and Inquisition of Kozilek, the deck aims to set up a powerful combo where Cosmogoyf can be brought back from the graveyard as a huge threat. Chancellor of the Annex is used to disrupt the opponent's plays while digging for the necessary pieces to execute the combo. Thud is the finishing move that can deal massive damage to the opponent using the graveyard creatures.
